cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Ballet originated in the courts of Renaissance Italy and France in the 15th and 16th centuries

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: King Louis XIV of France established the Académie Royale de Danse in 1661, professionalising ballet

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Romantic ballet emerged in the 1830s with ethereal themes and pointe work, such as La Sylphide

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Classical ballet peaked in late 19th-century Russia with works like Swan Lake and The Sleeping Beauty

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Isadora Duncan rebelled against ballet's rigidity in the early 1900s, pioneering free expressive movement

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Martha Graham developed a technique based on contraction and release, becoming a pillar of modern dance

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Merce Cunningham introduced chance procedures and separated dance from music in the mid-20th century

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Contemporary dance blends elements of ballet, modern and postmodern dance from the 1980s onwards

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Hip-hop dance emerged from African American and Latino communities in the Bronx during the 1970s

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: World dance traditions such as Bharatanatyam, Kathak and Flamenco have influenced contemporary choreography

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: The UK contemporary dance scene flourished with choreographers like Christopher Bruce and Matthew Bourne

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance History & Timeline
cards.back: Understanding dance history helps contextualise professional works studied in AQA 8236
